assets.name: shop
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: polished original Phaser children's dollhouse game environment background for Mia's World; one complete raster image, landscape 16:10, 1536x960 preferred.
Style/medium: warm sophisticated hand-painted vector-like picture-book illustration. Crisp rounded shapes, fine dark-teal contours, subtle paper texture, gentle shaded forms, rich small crafted details concentrated at scene edges. Color palette: sunny coral, peach, cream, turquoise, mint and forest green, lavender-blue accents. Cozy bright daylight.
Composition/framing: flat front-view dollhouse slice, readable gentle room depth, no dramatic isometric angle. Full-bleed composition with clear interactive negative space, no frame. Consistent visual language suitable for a matching series.
Constraints: original design only. No characters, people, animals, text, numbers, lettering, logos, watermarks, user interface or UI icons. Avoid clutter in spaces reserved for interactive overlays.
Primary request: Cozy mint and peach ice-cream gelateria interior.
Scene/backdrop: turquoise cabinetry across the back wall; large arched window at the upper left showing leafy trees; striped coral-and-cream awning at the upper right; warm cream tile walls; hanging warm pendant lights; edge plants, wooden shelf and decorative empty dishes.
Composition details: The foreground counter spans horizontally from x=20% to x=80% at around y=60% to y=76%. Broad clear continuous cream countertop with ABSOLUTELY NO ice-cream scoops, cones, dishes, jars, or objects painted on it. A generous warm patterned floor is visible in the bottom 25%. Leave left cabinet area x=5%-22%, y=35%-60% simple and empty for a freezer overlay. Leave right area x=80%-95%, y=50%-80% spacious and unoccupied for customer characters. Ambient ornaments only around edges and high walls. Cheerful immersive full scene.

Primary request: Sunny magical neighborhood park with a basketball court.
Scene/backdrop: lush rounded mint trees, distant little coral and peach houses, soft turquoise sky with a few cream clouds, soft hills, terracotta paths, bunting high across left side. A picnic bench at far left and a playful slide in the far-left background; soft foreground leaves at the outer corners.
Composition details: A clear broad ochre-and-turquoise basketball court occupies the center and right of the bottom 65% of the composition. The court surface should have restrained cream boundary lines and lots of uncluttered playable space. Leave a large open patch x=70%-90%, y=25%-55% with clear pale sky or calm distant backdrop so an interactive hoop overlay is very readable. NO painted-in basketball hoop, basket, backboard, ball, net or player. Keep all park furniture toward far left and outer margins. Friendly sunny depth and clear negative space.
